name: Sparkle trail
summary: A bright sparkle flies along an arc from one point to another, leaving a fading trail of twinkles; for magic moves.

params.name: s
params.note: scale about the middle of the path

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different trail jitter

params.name: color
params.note: accent colour of the lead sparkle

author: krakujs
